integrity: The transfer law is derived exactly from the pair-difference distribution and integer-shift identities for the remaining convolution. Endpoints follow by majorization; exact-rational computation only replays the formulas.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes mutually independent Bernoulli summands.
The local identity is for two-coordinate fixed-sum balancing; no global norm-stability remainder is claimed.
The originality search was targeted and may miss an equivalent identity in older stochastic-order or reliability literature.
title: Exact pair-balancing law for Gini dispersion of Poisson-binomial sums
